feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 9 May 2026 7:43am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 09 May 2026 at 7:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving low over the Norwegian Sea. High to the far west of Ireland, with a ridge to Hebrides.


##Wind##

Mainly northerly 4 or 5, but 5 or 6 in the west of the area, veering mainly northeast later today, then decreasing mostly 3 or 4 overnight but still 4 or 5 in the southwest of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Showers near the English and Welsh coasts this morning, but otherwise mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate near the British coast at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Mainly northeast 3 or 4, but 4 or 5 in the southwest at first, backing northwest during Sunday afternoon, increasing 4 or 5 in the far north. Then generally west-northwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6, overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
